verdict.rationale: LangSmith's API host serves a full OpenAPI 3.1 document at /openapi.json, and the same spec is published on the docs site and listed in llms.txt under OpenAPI Specs. A Swagger UI and ReDoc render it. The probe's 404s were on different docs.langchain.com paths, so they do not contradict the documented spec location. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on probe confirmation that the documented spec URL downloads successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The production API host serves its full machine-readable spec at the well-known path: an OpenAPI 3.1 document with info title "LangSmith"
The same spec is published on the docs site (docs.langchain.com/langsmith/langsmith-platform-openapi.json, listed in the docs llms.txt under "## OpenAPI Specs").
The API host itself serves an interactive Swagger UI (page title "LangSmith - Swagger UI", loading /openapi.json), with ReDoc live at /redoc.
